tools.name: flightaware_search_scheduled
tools.description: Scheduled (future) flights between two airports in a date window via the official FlightAware AeroAPI /schedules endpoint: ident, operator, scheduled out/in times and aircraft type per flight. Use it to see what actually flies a route on given days; it returns no prices. Requires the FLIGHTAWARE_API
